title: glandularia flava
intro: Glandularia flava, commonly known as Rock Rose or Yellow Butterfly Plant, is a flowering plant in the Verbenaceae family. This plant is rich in medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia flava include sedative and anxiolytic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and promoting a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm their specific effects.
